title: "I’m stuck"
last-reviewed: "2026-08-28"
---

Use this five-minute triage to identify what is blocking the work and where the decision belongs. It says nothing about your ability.

## First: is this urgent or unsafe?

Use appropriate local help now for imminent danger, serious distress, participant harm, bullying or harassment, discrimination, suspected misconduct, privacy or data breach, legal threat, or pressure to act outside an approval. Do not wait to complete this diagnostic. The handbook cannot provide emergency response, investigate a case or guarantee confidentiality.

## Five-minute diagnostic

1. Write the observable outcome you are trying to produce.
2. Name the smallest decision preventing movement.
3. Separate what is known, assumed and missing.
4. Classify the blockage: clarity, evidence, skill, access, permission, capacity, relationship, technical state or risk.
5. Name who can act or decide.
6. Choose one safe action that resolves the blockage or produces decisive evidence.
7. Set the date at which you will change route or escalate.

::: {.decision-card}
If the next action still reads “work on thesis”, make it smaller: verb + object + location/context + evidence of done.
:::

## What to take when asking for help

Bring the outcome, blocked decision, evidence checked, constraints, options, provisional recommendation, deadline/risk and one precise request. Use the [escalation message builder](../templates/escalation-message.qmd) if an agreed route has failed or direct resolution is inappropriate.

## You are moving again when

The next action has begun or the authorised decision has been made; its result is recorded; downstream work is updated; and a review threshold exists. A message sent or meeting booked is progress, but not necessarily resolution.

## When the doctorate is difficult to live with

For isolation, exhaustion, funding worries, comparison with peers, difficult supervision, whether to continue and career uncertainty, start with [Isolation, money, exhaustion and whether to continue](life-during-a-phd.qmd).
